item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"queue_size","expression":"len(self._heap)","rationale":"Captures linear heap rebuilding and list element shifting after removal."},{"name":"heapify_internal_nodes","expression":"(len(self._heap) - 1) // 2","rationale":"Counts internal nodes processed by heapify after removing one request."},{"name":"target_at_second_slot","expression":"int(len(self._heap) > 1 and self._heap[1] is request)","rationale":"Cheap indicator of removal search length and which early heap position is disturbed in this workload."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is dominated by heapify's linear traversal, its number of internal nodes, and variation in the removed request's position."}
